scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle going in the same direction, then returning to the original lane.
A person who drives or is in charge of a vehicle on a highway.
A person riding a bicycle or motor-assisted bicycle.
The part of the highway that is improved, designed or ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, not including the shoulder.
The part of the highway beside the ROADWAY, paved or unpaved, that is not the ROADWAY.
A broken (dashed) painted line separating lanes of traffic.
A continuous painted line separating lanes of traffic.
A portion of a roadway designated by by-law, marked with signs and pavement markings, where pedestrians may cross and drivers must yield to them.
A place where a railway track crosses a highway at the same level.
A chrome-yellow bus marked 'School Bus' that carries children or developmentally disabled persons and is equipped with overhead red signal-lights and a stop arm.
A car of an electric railway operated on rails on a highway.
A raised or marked area in the roadway beside a STREETCAR stop where passengers wait or get on and off.
A police, fire, ambulance or other emergency vehicle, or a tow truck, showing flashing red, red and blue, or amber lights as prescribed.
A regulatory sign telling drivers not to pass other vehicles.
A yellow pennant-shaped warning sign on the left side of the road marking the start of a no-passing zone.
A farm tractor, self-propelled implement of husbandry or other vehicle that travels at 40 km/h or less and displays the orange-and-red triangular slow-moving vehicle sign.

rules.title: Pass only when the way is clear
rules.when: intending to pass another vehicle going in the same direction
rules.action: pass or attempt to pass
rules.unless: the ROADWAY in front of and to the left of the vehicle to be passed is safely free from approaching traffic AND the ROADWAY to the left of the DRIVER is safely free from overtaking traffic
rules.statement: WHEN intending to pass another vehicle going in the same direction, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass or attempt to pass, UNLESS the ROADWAY in front of and to the left of the vehicle to be passed is safely free from approaching traffic AND the ROADWAY to the left of the DRIVER is safely free from overtaking traffic.
rules.penalty: A fine and 3 demerit points (improper passing).

vague_terms.explanation: no gap, time or sight distance given

rules.note: HTA s.148(8). Demerit value is from the improper-passing entry and may differ by charge.

rules.title: Turn out left far enough
rules.when: overtaking another vehicle or a person on horseback
rules.action: turn out to the left as far as necessary to avoid a collision with the vehicle or person being overtaken
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking another vehicle or a person on horseback, the PASSER MUST turn out to the left as far as necessary to avoid a collision with the vehicle or person being overtaken.

rules.title: Do not speed to pass
rules.when: making a PASS
rules.action: exceed the speed limit
rules.statement: WHEN making a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT exceed the speed limit.
rules.note: Handbook: never exceed the speed limit to pass; speeding is separately an offence.

rules.title: Check mirrors and blind spot
rules.when: about to move out to PASS
rules.action: check the mirrors and the blind spot for vehicles in the passing lane ahead and behind
rules.statement: WHEN about to move out to PASS, the PASSER MUST check the mirrors and the blind spot for vehicles in the passing lane ahead and behind.
rules.note: Handbook passing procedure.

rules.title: Signal before moving out
rules.when: moving from the PASSER's lane into the passing lane
rules.action: signal the lane change with the turn signal
rules.statement: WHEN moving from the PASSER's lane into the passing lane, the PASSER MUST signal the lane change with the turn signal.
rules.note: HTA s.142 requires a signal when moving from one lane to another where other traffic may be affected; the handbook says to signal before passing.

rules.title: Signal before returning
rules.when: returning to the original lane after passing
rules.action: signal the lane change to the right
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after passing, the PASSER MUST signal the lane change to the right.
rules.note: HTA s.142; handbook passing procedure.

rules.title: Do not cut back in too soon
rules.when: returning to the original lane after passing
rules.action: move back in front of the passed vehicle before being able to see the front of that vehicle in the inside rear-view mirror
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after passing, the PASSER MUST NOT move back in front of the passed vehicle before being able to see the front of that vehicle in the inside rear-view mirror.
rules.note: Handbook passing procedure.

rules.title: Cancel signal
rules.when: the PASS is complete
rules.action: cancel the turn signal
rules.statement: WHEN the PASS is complete, the PASSER MUST cancel the turn signal.
rules.note: Handbook passing procedure.

rules.title: No passing on hills, curves, near bridges or tunnels
rules.when: on a ROADWAY with traffic in both directions AND approaching the crest of a grade OR on a curve OR within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel AND the DRIVER's view is obstructed so as to create a potential hazard
rules.action: drive to the left of the centre of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: the highway is one-way OR the highway is marked with more lanes for the DRIVER's direction than for the other direction
rules.statement: WHEN on a ROADWAY with traffic in both directions AND approaching the crest of a grade OR on a curve OR within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel AND the DRIVER's view is obstructed so as to create a potential hazard, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive to the left of the centre of the ROADWAY, UNLESS the highway is one-way OR the highway is marked with more lanes for the DRIVER's direction than for the other direction.
rules.penalty: A fine and 3 demerit points (improper passing).

vague_terms.term: view is obstructed so as to create a potential hazard

rules.note: HTA s.149. Exact wording of the exceptions is from memory.

rules.title: No passing near a railway crossing
rules.when: on a ROADWAY with traffic in both directions AND within 30 metres of a LEVEL RAILWAY CROSSING
rules.action: drive to the left of the centre of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: the highway is one-way OR the highway is marked with more lanes for the DRIVER's direction than for the other direction
rules.statement: WHEN on a ROADWAY with traffic in both directions AND within 30 metres of a LEVEL RAILWAY CROSSING, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive to the left of the centre of the ROADWAY, UNLESS the highway is one-way OR the highway is marked with more lanes for the DRIVER's direction than for the other direction.
rules.penalty: A fine and 3 demerit points (improper passing).
rules.note: HTA s.149.

rules.title: No passing near a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: approaching a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle that is within 30 metres of the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass any vehicle that is within 30 metres of the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER.
rules.note: HTA s.140. Fines for crossover offences are doubled in community safety zones.

rules.title: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crossover
rules.when: another vehicle is stopped at a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: overtake and pass the stopped vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is stopped at a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT overtake and pass the stopped vehicle.
rules.note: HTA s.140; subsection numbering not certain.

rules.title: Do Not Pass sign
rules.when: in the area governed by a DO NOT PASS SIGN
rules.action: pass other vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN in the area governed by a DO NOT PASS SIGN, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass other vehicles.
rules.note: Regulatory sign shown in the handbook.

rules.title: No passing zone pennant
rules.when: passing a NO PASSING ZONE SIGN
rules.action: pass other vehicles in the no-passing zone that follows
rules.statement: WHEN passing a NO PASSING ZONE SIGN, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT pass other vehicles in the no-passing zone that follows.
rules.note: Warning sign; the zone is normally also marked with a SOLID LINE. Strength recorded as advice because it is a warning sign, not a regulatory one.

rules.title: Solid line: unsafe to pass
rules.when: there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT pass.
rules.note: Handbook: a solid line at the left of your lane means it is unsafe to pass. Applies also where a solid line is paired with a broken line and the solid line is on the DRIVER's side.

rules.title: Broken line: passing allowed
rules.when: there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS safely
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS safely, the PASSER MAY pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.note: Applies also where a broken line is paired with a solid line and the broken line is on the PASSER's side.

rules.title: Double solid lines: no passing
rules.when: there are double SOLID LINEs between the lanes
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there are double SOLID LINEs between the lanes, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass.
rules.note: Handbook: with double solid lines neither driver may pass. Not certain this is stated as law in the HTA.

rules.title: Passing on the right
rules.when: the movement can be made in safety AND the vehicle being passed is making or signalling a left turn OR the highway has unobstructed pavement wide enough for two or more lanes moving in the DRIVER's direction OR the highway is one-way
rules.action: overtake and pass to the right of a vehicle or STREETCAR
rules.statement: WHEN the movement can be made in safety AND the vehicle being passed is making or signalling a left turn OR the highway has unobstructed pavement wide enough for two or more lanes moving in the DRIVER's direction OR the highway is one-way, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MAY ONLY overtake and pass to the right of a vehicle or STREETCAR.
rules.penalty: A fine and 3 demerit points (improper passing).
rules.note: HTA s.150(1). Read as: passing on the right is allowed only when safe and one of the three conditions holds.

rules.title: Never pass on the shoulder
rules.when: passing a vehicle on the right
rules.action: drive off the ROADWAY or onto the SHOULDER, paved or not, to make the PASS
rules.statement: WHEN passing a vehicle on the right, the PASSER MUST NOT drive off the ROADWAY or onto the SHOULDER, paved or not, to make the PASS.
rules.note: HTA s.150 prohibits passing on the right by driving off the roadway; the handbook says never pass on the shoulder, paved or not. There may be narrow statutory exceptions (e.g. direction by police or signs) not listed here.

rules.title: Cyclists: one metre
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: leave at least 1 metre between the motor vehicle and the bicycle, as nearly as practicable, and keep that distance until safely past
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST leave at least 1 metre between the motor vehicle and the bicycle, as nearly as practicable, and keep that distance until safely past.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when 1 metre is impractical

rules.title: Change lanes to pass a cyclist
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST AND the lane is too narrow to share
rules.action: change lanes to pass
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST AND the lane is too narrow to share, the DRIVER SHOULD change lanes to pass.
rules.note: Handbook advice; exact wording not certain.

rules.title: School bus from behind
rules.when: approaching from behind a stopped SCHOOL BUS with its overhead red signal-lights flashing
rules.action: stop at least 20 metres before reaching the bus and not proceed until the bus moves or the lights stop flashing
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from behind a stopped SCHOOL BUS with its overhead red signal-lights flashing, the DRIVER MUST stop at least 20 metres before reaching the bus and not proceed until the bus moves or the lights stop flashing.
rules.penalty: First offence $400 to $2,000 and 6 demerit points; higher fines and possible jail for repeat offences.
rules.note: HTA s.175. Applies on all roads, including multi-lane roads, for traffic behind the bus.

rules.title: School bus from the front
rules.when: approaching from the front a stopped SCHOOL BUS with its overhead red signal-lights flashing
rules.action: stop before reaching the bus and not proceed until the bus moves or the lights stop flashing
rules.unless: the highway is divided by a median strip
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from the front a stopped SCHOOL BUS with its overhead red signal-lights flashing, the DRIVER MUST stop before reaching the bus and not proceed until the bus moves or the lights stop flashing, UNLESS the highway is divided by a median strip.
rules.penalty: First offence $400 to $2,000 and 6 demerit points.
rules.note: HTA s.175.

rules.title: Stopped streetcar
rules.when: overtaking a STREETCAR that is stopped to take on or let off passengers
rules.action: stop at least 2 metres behind the rear doors and not proceed until the passengers have got on or off and reached the side of the road
rules.unless: there is a SAFETY ISLAND at the stop
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a STREETCAR that is stopped to take on or let off passengers, the DRIVER MUST stop at least 2 metres behind the rear doors and not proceed until the passengers have got on or off and reached the side of the road, UNLESS there is a SAFETY ISLAND at the stop.
rules.note: HTA s.166; handbook.

rules.title: Streetcar with safety island
rules.when: overtaking a stopped STREETCAR AND there is a SAFETY ISLAND at the stop
rules.action: pass at a reasonable speed while watching for pedestrians
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a stopped STREETCAR AND there is a SAFETY ISLAND at the stop, the DRIVER MAY pass at a reasonable speed while watching for pedestrians.
rules.note: Handbook wording; HTA s.166 may set a specific maximum speed (possibly 10 km/h) that is not confirmed here.

rules.title: Streetcar on the left
rules.when: overtaking a STREETCAR
rules.action: pass on the left side of the STREETCAR
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a STREETCAR, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass on the left side of the STREETCAR, UNLESS the street is one-way.
rules.note: Handbook.

rules.title: Slow down for stopped emergency vehicle
rules.when: approaching a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its lights flashing in the same direction of travel
rules.action: slow down and pass with caution, having due regard for traffic, road and weather conditions
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its lights flashing in the same direction of travel, the DRIVER MUST slow down and pass with caution, having due regard for traffic, road and weather conditions.
rules.penalty: First offence $400 to $2,000, 3 demerit points and possible licence suspension up to 2 years.
rules.note: HTA s.159(2). Tow trucks with amber lights are included; coverage of other roadside vehicles not confirmed.

rules.title: Move over for stopped emergency vehicle
rules.when: approaching a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its lights flashing in the same direction of travel AND the highway has two or more lanes in that direction
rules.action: move into a lane away from the EMERGENCY VEHICLE if it can be done safely
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its lights flashing in the same direction of travel AND the highway has two or more lanes in that direction, the DRIVER MUST move into a lane away from the EMERGENCY VEHICLE if it can be done safely.
rules.penalty: First offence $400 to $2,000, 3 demerit points and possible licence suspension up to 2 years.

vague_terms.term: if it can be done safely

rules.title: Returning after passing a large vehicle
rules.when: returning to the lane in front of a LARGE VEHICLE that has been passed
rules.action: move back in until the whole front of the LARGE VEHICLE is visible in the inside rear-view mirror, or slow down after moving in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the lane in front of a LARGE VEHICLE that has been passed, the PASSER MUST NOT move back in until the whole front of the LARGE VEHICLE is visible in the inside rear-view mirror, or slow down after moving in front of it.
rules.note: Handbook guidance on sharing the road with large vehicles.

rules.title: Do not pass snowplows
rules.when: following a snowplow that is working OR snowplows working side by side in a staggered formation
rules.action: pass the snowplow or drive between the snowplows
rules.statement: WHEN following a snowplow that is working OR snowplows working side by side in a staggered formation, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the snowplow or drive between the snowplows.
rules.note: From MTO winter driving guidance ('never pass a snowplow'); not certain it appears in the same words in the driver's handbook. Not an HTA rule.

rules.title: Care passing slow-moving vehicles
rules.when: coming up behind a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE
rules.action: slow down, keep well back, and pass only when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN coming up behind a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE, the DRIVER SHOULD slow down, keep well back, and pass only when it is safe.
rules.note: Handbook advice; exact wording not certain.

rules.title: Move right and let the vehicle pass
rules.when: being overtaken by a vehicle or person on horseback travelling at a greater speed
rules.action: turn out to the right and allow the overtaking vehicle or person to pass
rules.statement: WHEN being overtaken by a vehicle or person on horseback travelling at a greater speed, the DRIVER MUST turn out to the right and allow the overtaking vehicle or person to pass.
rules.penalty: A fine and 2 demerit points (failing to share the road).

rules.title: Half the roadway is enough
rules.when: being overtaken
rules.action: keep up to one-half of the ROADWAY, without leaving more than one-half free for the PASSER
rules.statement: WHEN being overtaken, the DRIVER MAY keep up to one-half of the ROADWAY, without leaving more than one-half free for the PASSER.
rules.note: HTA s.148(5): the person overtaken is not required to leave more than one-half of the roadway free.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: being passed
rules.action: speed up
rules.statement: WHEN being passed, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up.
rules.note: Handbook; not confirmed as a separate HTA offence.

rules.title: Cyclist being overtaken
rules.when: being overtaken by a vehicle or person on horseback travelling at a greater speed
rules.action: turn out to the right and allow the vehicle or person to pass
rules.statement: WHEN being overtaken by a vehicle or person on horseback travelling at a greater speed, the CYCLIST MUST turn out to the right and allow the vehicle or person to pass.
rules.note: HTA s.148(6); the overtaking vehicle must also turn out left as far as necessary to avoid a collision.

rules.title: Slower traffic keep right
rules.when: travelling at less than the normal speed of traffic at that time and place
rules.action: drive in the right-hand lane then available for traffic, or as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway, where practicable
rules.statement: WHEN travelling at less than the normal speed of traffic at that time and place, the DRIVER MUST drive in the right-hand lane then available for traffic, or as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway, where practicable.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when it is impractical

rules.note: HTA s.147(1); does not apply to a vehicle overtaking or preparing for a left turn.

rules.title: Help large vehicles pass
rules.when: being passed by a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: keep to the right and slow down slightly
rules.statement: WHEN being passed by a LARGE VEHICLE, the DRIVER SHOULD keep to the right and slow down slightly.
rules.note: Handbook advice on sharing the road with large vehicles; exact wording not certain.
